The '''''Republic's Return''''' was a [[Star Cruiser/Legends|star cruiser]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in the [[Evacuation of Yavin|evacuation]] of its [[Great Temple/Legends|base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="TMDF">{{JournalCite|11|The Most Dangerous Foe}}</ref>
